newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Nationalists to invest in US, Australia.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Nationalists to invest in US, Australia.

text.p: Taiwan's ruling Nationalist Party, one of the world's wealthiest political parties, said on Monday it has approved two investment projects in the United States and Australia.

A Nationalist statement said the party's Central Investment Holding Co would participate in a US$120 million joint-venture with U.S. firm Alaska Seafood Centre to build a seafood processing centre there.
Central Investment Holding, which would own 50 percent of the stake, planned to invest US$16 million, with the remaining borrowing from Alaskan government and banks, it said.
Another Nationalist firm would set up a A$3.5 million joint-venture with Australia's Aussie Prawns Pty Ltd.
The Nationalists would invest A$1.75 million, or 50 percent of the total.
The Nationalist Party, which owns seven holding companies with investments in 121 companies on the island, had total assets of over T$85 billion (US$3.09 billion) at end-December 1996.
